# Pensyve

> Pensyve provides persistent AI agent memory through Python, an MCP memory server, and a self-hosted HTTP gateway. It is licensed under Apache 2.0.

Pensyve Cloud closed on October 1, 2026. The hosted dashboard, API, and MCP service
are unavailable. The open-source project is in maintenance mode, with security
fixes and dependency updates but no new features.

The Rust engine stores memories in SQLite by default, and the core has an
optional Postgres backend. Python runs the engine in process. TypeScript and
Go clients connect to a gateway that you host. MCP clients can run the local
stdio server or connect to the gateway's `/mcp` endpoint.

Local use needs no Pensyve account or API key. Embedding models may download
from Hugging Face when first loaded, so prepare the model cache before running
without internet access. Cross-encoder reranking is disabled by default.

## Start here

- [Project README](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/README.md): Installation and examples for local Python, MCP, CLI, and a self-hosted gateway.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/docs/README.md): Setup by client or framework, usage guides, and historical plans.
- [Maintenance policy](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/MAINTENANCE.md): Project status and contribution scope.
- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/docs/self-host.md): Gateway configuration, storage, authentication, and backups.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Private vulnerability reporting.

## SDKs and binaries

Install Python with `pip install pensyve`, TypeScript with
`npm install @pensyve/sdk`, or Go with
`go get github.com/major7apps/pensyve/pensyve-go/v5@latest`.

From a repository checkout, install the MCP server with
`cargo install --locked --path pensyve-mcp` and the CLI with
`cargo install --locked --path pensyve-cli`. The executable names are
`pensyve-mcp` and `pensyve`. Source builds require Rust 1.94 or later.

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/pensyve-python/README.md): Python 3.10 or later, local facts, episodes, grouped recall, consolidation, and deletion snapshots.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/pensyve-ts/src/index.ts): HTTP client API and types.
- [Go SDK](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/pensyve-go/client.go): HTTP client API. `NewClient` returns both a client and an error.
- [MCP tools](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/pensyve-mcp-tools/src/server.rs): Tool names, parameters, and handlers. Names use the `pensyve_` prefix.

## Plugins and integrations

- [Integration index](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/README.md): Framework adapters and MCP client setup guides.
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/claude-code/README.md): Local MCP and self-hosted gateway configuration.
- [Codex plugin](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/codex-plugin/README.md): Plugin installation and local stdio setup.
- [Antigravity CLI plugin](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/antigravity-plugin/README.md): Plugin and MCP configuration.

For other common setups, use the [Cursor guide](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/cursor/README.md)
or the [LangChain and LangGraph guide](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve/blob/main/integrations/langchain/README.md).
